name: cov
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::cov(Tensor self, *, int correction=1, Tensor? fweights=None, Tensor? aweights=None) -> Tensor. Computes covariance for one- or two-dimensional observations without mutating or aliasing inputs. Tests cover correction values, frequency and analytic weights individually and together, scalar and matrix outputs, noncontiguous input, metadata, non-mutation, and invalid weight length.
